headword: コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}
reading: こみゅにけーしょんのうりょく

definitions.explanation: The ability to communicate effectively with others, including speaking, listening, reading social cues, and building relationships. Highly valued in Japanese society and frequently cited as a key trait in job recruitment.

examples.japanese: コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}が{高|たか}い{人|ひと}は{職場|しょくば}で{重宝|ちょうほう}される。
examples.english: People with strong communication skills are valued in the workplace.

examples.japanese: {就活|しゅうかつ}ではコミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}が{最|もっと}も{重視|じゅうし}される。
examples.english: In job hunting, communication skills are considered the most important quality.

examples.japanese: コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}を{高|たか}めるためには、{日頃|ひごろ}から{人|ひと}と{積極的|せっきょくてき}に{関|かか}わることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: To improve your communication skills, it's important to actively interact with people on a daily basis.

notes:
A compound of the loanword コミュニケーション (communication) and {能力|のうりょく} (ability). Extremely frequently abbreviated to コミュ{力|りょく} (komyuryoku) or simply コミュ{力|りょく} in casual speech and writing.

COMMON ABBREVIATION:
コミュ{力|りょく} (komyuryoku) — the standard informal abbreviation, widely used in everyday conversation, social media, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い — to have high/low communication skills
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}を{磨|みが}く — to polish one's communication skills
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}を{高|たか}める — to improve communication skills
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}を{問|と}う — to assess communication ability

RELATED WORDS:
- コミュ{障|しょう} — communication difficulties (slang, short for コミュニケーション{障害|しょうがい}; used self-deprecatingly for social awkwardness)
- {対人|たいじん}{能力|のうりょく} — interpersonal ability
- {社交性|しゃこうせい} — sociability
- {話術|わじゅつ} — art of conversation; speaking skills

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese employers consistently rank コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく} as the most desired quality in new graduates. In the Japanese context, this encompasses not just speaking ability but also the capacity to read the atmosphere ({空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む), collaborate harmoniously, and express oneself with appropriate sensitivity to social context.
